fov_source: vget /camera/N/fov read back from the engine after being set
K_applies_to: the delivered rgb.mp4 frames, unmodified since render
source_axis_convention: UE: left-handed, X forward, Y right, Z up, centimetres
canonical_axis_convention: x right, y down, z forward, metres, camera-to-world, column vectors
ue_to_canonical_basis: canonical columns are (right, -up, forward) of the UE camera basis
rotation_truth: quaternion (quat_x..quat_w) and the 4x4 c2w; both are derived from the engine's Euler readback of the CameraComponent, which is the only rotation form this build exposes. Euler is kept for reading.

not_available.near_far_clip: not exposed by UnrealCV on this build

depth.format: EXR, linear metres, in the R channel; G and B are 0, A is 1
depth.reader_warning: OpenCV decodes EXR as BGRA, so with cv2.imread the depth is index 2, not 0. Index 0 is an all-zero plane that looks exactly like a failed capture. An opencv build reporting `OpenEXR: NO` returns None for a perfectly good file.
depth.invalid_meaning: sky, unwritten pixels, and anything beyond max_range_m. Not a measurement. Mask with depth > 0 before unprojecting.
depth.kind: planar (distance along the camera view axis), not radial
depth.source: SimWorldCapture::CaptureDepthEXR - SCS_SceneDepth into an RTF_R32f target, read back with FRHIGPUTextureReadback. NOT ReadLinearColorPixels, which on Vulkan is not a float path and fires a checkf for R32F.
depth.verified: centre pixel agreed with an independent line trace to 0.0-0.4 cm at 3.6-4.2 m and within 0.8% at 180-270 m
depth.pose: captured at the ACTUAL camera pose read back from the engine, not the commanded pose
